scene.title: How a neural network recognises a cat
scene.summary: Pixels become features, features flow through hidden layers, and the output neuron with the highest activation decides the class.

beats.title: Image enters
beats.narration: The picture is fed as a grid of pixel intensities.

beats.title: First layer detects edges
beats.narration: The first hidden layer responds to simple patterns like edges and corners.

beats.title: Deeper layer finds cat parts
beats.narration: Later layers combine edges into shapes such as ears and whiskers, forming a cat concept.

check.question: Which output neuron will fire strongest?
check.explain: The cat neuron receives the strongest combined evidence.

beats.title: Prediction
beats.narration: The output neuron for cat has the highest activation, so the network predicts a cat.

beats.title: Takeaway
beats.narration: A neural network transforms raw pixels into high‑level concepts, ending with the most confident class label.
